title: The World Learns Its Own Name
central_question: How can pressure in air become a word that means something, and why does meaning arrive as recognition rather than as a sequence of acoustic pieces?
thesis: Meaning is neither a substance stored inside sound nor a private object added after hearing. It is an event in which embodied prediction, shared use, context, and reflexive awareness make a temporal pattern intelligible as a whole.

artistic_world.name: phononic cathedral
artistic_world.material: obsidian liquid glass carrying spectral pressure, caustic refraction, granular breath and luminous semantic weather
artistic_world.camera_rule: the camera is progressively implicated in the utterance: witness, resonator, predictor, speaker, then the field in which speaking and hearing meet
forbidden: four levels of speech shown as a stacked infographic
audio uniforms used only as exposure controls

state_space.name: Meaning State Vector

articulation.high: sharp phonemic, visual and harmonic differentiation
articulation.visual: edge acuity, spectral separation and glyph-like segmentation
articulation.music: attack precision, register contrast and interval definition
articulation.narrative: degree to which claims and images become explicitly discriminated

continuity.low: fragments are heard and seen as separate events
continuity.high: successive events are carried as one evolving gesture
continuity.visual: trail persistence, field advection and morph duration
continuity.music: common tones, legato overlap and motif retention
continuity.narrative: sentence span and the amount of unresolved material carried forward

deixis.low: no privileged speaker, object or here
deixis.high: the utterance points strongly toward an owner or named object
deixis.visual: directional convergence, aperture bias and local framing
deixis.music: tonic insistence, register anchoring and call-response asymmetry
deixis.narrative: intensity of I, you, this and named identity

resonance.high: sound, image, expectation and harmony reinforce one another
resonance.visual: phase-locking, coherent caustics and cross-modal color agreement
resonance.music: spectral consonance and alignment of motif voices
resonance.narrative: felt fit between evidence, metaphor and claim

prosody.low: irregular timing without a reliable stress contour
prosody.high: strong pulse, recurrence and phrase-shaped expectation
prosody.visual: wave spacing, breath accents and travelling pressure fronts
prosody.music: grid reliability, meter and phrase periodicity
prosody.narrative: cadence, pause placement and rhetorical recurrence

semantic_density.high: many relations are compressed into each event
semantic_density.visual: nested interference, contextual echoes and relational topology
semantic_density.music: polyphony, harmonic extension and motivic implication
semantic_density.narrative: conceptual compression and dependence on earlier passages

state_space.warning: These axes are compositional controls. They are not measurements of consciousness, meaning, neural activity or rasa.

rasa_model.method: Each interval has a dominant and supporting rasa. The pair governs the relation among movement, color, register, pacing and narrative address; it is not converted into coordinates.
rasa_model.global_arc: shanta -> adbhuta -> shringara -> hasya -> vira -> bhayanaka -> karuna -> adbhuta -> raudra -> adbhuta -> shanta -> shringara
rasa_model.intended_aftertaste: Speech returns ordinary and miraculous: not a code pasted onto reality, but reality becoming answerable and shareable.

tattva_model.method: Tattva level is used as an explicitly artistic constraint index: higher values open the field and reduce object-bound geometry; lower values condense it into sequential, sensory form.
tattva_model.warning: The selected levels do not claim historical correspondences between tattvas, phonemes, MIDI notes, brain states or visual density. Conventional Earth=1 and Shiva=36 numbering is used.

waypoints.title: Before sound knows it is a word
waypoints.camera: Suspended inside black-violet breath with no visible source.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: The ear and eye search for a signal but meet a living continuum.
waypoints.narrative_function: Separate physical vibration from meaning without making either feel dead.

waypoints.title: A recurrence begins to ask for memory
waypoints.camera: A copper filament repeats across depth, never from exactly the same place.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Difference becomes expectation before it becomes a phoneme.
waypoints.narrative_function: Make temporal comparison and memory prerequisites for hearing form.

waypoints.title: The body gives vibration a chamber
waypoints.camera: The field passes through a vast off-axis glass throat whose shape continuously tunes it.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Breath acquires color, pitch and intimacy through a body.
waypoints.narrative_function: Show articulation as embodied filtering rather than a symbolic label added to air.

waypoints.title: What surrounds a sound enters what is heard
waypoints.camera: Two incompatible visual articulators refract one ambiguous acoustic ribbon into a third event.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Perception becomes playful and unreliable without becoming arbitrary.

music.chord: F major over A with shifting third

waypoints.narrative_function: Introduce multisensory integration, predictive context and phonemic restoration.

waypoints.title: A name makes one difference portable
waypoints.camera: A flowing world crystallizes into mobile categorical facets around the copper thread.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Naming feels empowering because it preserves a distinction across absence.

music.chord: A minor six with sharpened edge

waypoints.narrative_function: Explain categories as acts that stabilize relevance, not mirrors that copy ready-made essences.

waypoints.title: The word returns without entering the air
waypoints.camera: The breath-thread folds behind the camera and becomes a silent Möbius voice around a dark local aperture.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: A useful inner rehearsal begins to feel like a private speaker sealed inside.
waypoints.narrative_function: Treat inner speech as heterogeneous self-generated activity, then expose the owner it appears to install.

waypoints.title: The end of a sentence changes its beginning
waypoints.camera: Separated spectral shards travel across time and disclose one large moving organism only when the final shard arrives.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Meaning is felt retroactively as a whole that reorganizes its own parts.
waypoints.narrative_function: Prepare Bhartṛhari's sentence holism through temporal experience rather than definition.

waypoints.title: The whole flashes—but what flashed?
waypoints.camera: The sentence-organism flashes into total coherence, then fractures into rival explanations without losing its afterimage.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Wonder and intellectual conflict arrive in the same instant.
waypoints.narrative_function: Present sphota and pratibha, then state that Pratyabhijna thinkers did not simply accept sphota.

waypoints.title: Speech is deeper than the audible word
waypoints.camera: The camera passes obliquely through four continuously connected material regimes, never four labeled floors.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Audible sequence opens into silent organization, then into a nonsequential capacity for expression.
waypoints.narrative_function: Use vaikharī, madhyamā, paśyantī and parā as a metaphysical-linguistic descent while refusing brain-region equivalence.

waypoints.title: The listener appears inside the utterance
waypoints.camera: A vast pressure corridor turns through the viewpoint; the apparent receiver becomes one fold in the wave.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Hearing ceases to feel like an outside object delivered to an inner spectator.
waypoints.narrative_function: Move from language processing to the Pratyabhijna claim that awareness is reflexive and self-articulating.

waypoints.title: Meaning loses its container
waypoints.camera: All phonemic objects become one deep violet standing wave; at the end of silence, a copper seam learns to point without enclosing.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: The absence of sound is heard as the shared capacity from which sound and meaning arise.
waypoints.narrative_function: Let the audiovisual system enact the thesis before the key sentence names it.

waypoints.title: The world speaks without becoming a cage
waypoints.camera: Open calligraphic flocks cross a permeable copper horizon and remain visibly made from the original breath.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Language feels finite, embodied and participatory rather than false or absolute.

music.chord: A major six-nine with open eleven

waypoints.narrative_function: Return ordinary words as gifts that coordinate worlds while remaining transparent to what exceeds them.

waypoints.title: Breath keeps the meaning
waypoints.camera: The last semantic flock becomes breath again, but its relational afterimage remains in the whole field.
waypoints.audience_undergoes: Silence after speech is not the silence before it.
waypoints.narrative_function: Close the loop without erasing articulation, embodiment or plurality.

recognition_event.key_sentence: A word is not a container. It is the world arriving in a form it can recognize.

silence_windows.purpose: Camatkara aperture: the sentence cadence decays into a dark standing wave; the key line and completed motif return together.

visual_contract.transition_rule: Each material transformation begins causally inside the current one. Crossfades may carry history but may not replace the field with a new scene.
visual_contract.audio_rule: Audio features alter pressure, wave speed, segmentation, travel and phase-locking. They must never function only as final brightness multipliers.
visual_contract.text_rule: No on-screen explanatory text is required. The image must retain a coherent silent-viewing argument.

epistemic_limits: Phonemic restoration and audiovisual speech effects show constructive, contextual perception; they do not show that sensory evidence is irrelevant.
Predictive processing models mechanisms of inference and integration; it does not by itself explain why meaning is consciously experienced.
Bhartṛhari's sentence holism and pratibha are not neural theories.
Utpaladeva and Abhinavagupta drew deeply on Bhartṛhari while rejecting sphota; the film preserves that disagreement.
The four levels of speech are not mapped onto four brain regions or processing stages.
The Pratyabhijna claim that consciousness is reflexive and language-imbued is metaphysical and philosophical, not an empirical deduction from speech neuroscience.
